transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I don't know. Just... feel like I got a motor running inside me all day. If I have to sit still—like at church, or out there in the waiting room, or even just at home—I feel... trapped. I just have to get up and do something. So, that's why I came in.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're supposed to be sitting still?

Yeah... guess I do. Even if I'm trying to be respectful and just sit there, my leg's always bouncing. Or my fingers are tapping the chair. Just... twisting stuff in my hands the whole time. Can't really help it.
Do you feel anxious or worried when you're feeling trapped and need to get up and do something?
Uh... no. Not really. I ain't worried about nothing. Just... it's just a feeling in my body, like I gotta move. Ain't got nothing to do with being anxious. That's just how it is.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don't know. Not sure what you mean, really. I just... do what I do. Ain't really thought about it much.
Do you often do things without thinking about what might happen as a result?
Like I said... I don't really know. I ain't sitting around planning everything out. If I feel like doing something, I just... do it. Don't really look past that, I guess.
Do you ever get into physical fights or have trouble controlling your temper?
Nah... not really. I ain't out getting into fights or nothing. Just... keep to myself mostly. Don't really have a problem with that.
Do you often have trouble paying attention to details or following through on instructions?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... sometimes my relative asks me to run an errand, or I try to help out at the food pantry. I'll start it fine. But then... I don't know, I just do the first bit and kinda forget the rest. People always find out later I didn't actually finish what they told me to do.
Do you feel this way at work or at school, or is it just in certain situations like church or the waiting room?

I ain't working right now. And I ain't in school. So... it's mostly just around. Church, the pantry, with my family... 

It's gotten to where... well, they kinda stopped asking me to do stuff. They don't really trust me with giving people rides no more, or keeping track of appointments... or handling the supplies at the pantry. I mean, I want to help 'em out, but... I don't know. I just keep letting everybody down, I guess.
Have you always felt this way, even when you were a kid?

Yeah... I guess so. School was... well, it wasn't great. Teachers were always moving my desk. Said I couldn't sit still. I'd talk when I wasn't supposed to... get in trouble for getting out of my seat before the bell rang. Just... couldn't stay put, I guess.
Do you have trouble paying attention or following instructions at home, not just when you're trying to help out at places like the food pantry?
I don't know... ain't really noticed, I guess. I mean, home is just home. Ain't nobody really giving me instructions there. So... yeah. I'm not sure.
Do you have trouble organizing your daily activities or tasks?

...I guess. Just... things get all mixed up. My papers, the appointment cards... food boxes. Even the notes on my phone. I just look at it and... I can't figure what needs doing first. And then by the time I do, everything's already late. Or just... messed up. So, yeah.
Do you have trouble paying attention when you're doing things by yourself at home?
I don't really know. When I'm by myself, I just... do whatever. Ain't really keeping track of my attention or nothing. So... I couldn't tell you.
Did you have trouble sitting still and paying attention when you were little, like in elementary school?

...Yeah, I guess. Back when I was a boy in school... the teachers were always moving my seat. Just... couldn't stay put, I guess. I'd talk out of turn, and... get in trouble for jumping up before class was even done. So... yeah. I did.
Do you often interrupt others when they are speaking?

...I suppose. Folks get mad at me for it. I just... jump in with an answer before they're done talking. Like my cousin... or the pastor. Even the lady down at the pantry. I just say it, and then... realize I answered the wrong thing. Or they're just mad. So... yeah.
Do you think your main problem is that you can't sit still and have to be moving, or that you have trouble paying attention to things?

...It's the moving, I guess. I just... I feel like I got a motor running inside me. Pretty much all day. If I have to sit still... like at church, or out there in the clinic, or even just at the house... I can't do it. I just feel trapped. Like I have to get up and do something. So... yeah. That's the main thing.
Do you think you would have trouble sitting still even if you were doing something you really enjoyed?
...I don't know. I guess it depends. Even if it's something I like... I still get restless. Just... hard to stay put for too long.
Did you have these feelings of restlessness and trouble sitting still when you were a little kid, before you started school?

...Hard to remember much before I started school. But... yeah. Back when I was a boy in school... teachers were always moving my seat. I just couldn't stay put. I'd... talk out of turn. Always getting in trouble for jumping up before class was even done. So... yeah. Always been like that, I guess.
Do you think you would be able to focus on a task if you were allowed to move around while doing it?
...I don't know. Never really... thought about it like that. I guess... maybe? I ain't sure.
Have you had trouble sitting still or paying attention in lots of different places, not just at church or the food pantry?
...I guess so. Pretty much... everywhere I go. I don't really keep track of it all. Just... always been that way, I suppose.
Do you often blur out answers before the questions are finished being asked?

...Yeah, I guess. I tend to... jump in before folks finish talking. Like with the pastor, or... my cousin. The lady at the pantry, too. I just... say an answer before they're done. And then... I realize I answered the wrong thing. Or... they just get mad at me. So... yeah. Happens a lot.
